title: Canonical Grothendieck bottom and left edge maps
statement: For a composable acyclic pair of additive functors $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$ [def-sp-composite-acyclicity] and $n\geq0$, define the bottom edge $F\,R^nG\to R^n(GF)$ (when $F,G$ are left exact) by the canonical map from the bottom edge of the Grothendieck spectral object, transported through the canonical source and abutment identifications. Define the left edge $R^n(GF)\to G\,R^nF$ (when $G$ is left exact) by the canonical map from the left edge of that spectral object, transported through the canonical abutment and target identifications. These are natural transformations in the object of $\mathcal A$; their components are the indicated local-to-global edge arrows.
